couplets.en: Come, let us walk through the bazaar in chains today.
Tearful eyes and a restless soul are not enough.
Even the charge of loving in secret is not enough.
Come, let us walk through the bazaar in chains today.
Come with hands aloft, lost in the dance.
Come with dust on your head and blood on your hem.

lines: Raah takta hai sab shahr-e-jaanan chalo
couplets.en: Come, the whole city of the beloved is watching the road.
Come, let us walk through the bazaar in chains today.
The city's ruler is there, and so is the crowd.
There are arrows of accusation and stones of abuse.
There is the joyless dawn and the day that comes to nothing.
Come, let us walk through the bazaar in chains today.

lines: Unka dam-saz apne siwa kaun hai
couplets.en: Who but us is left to share their sorrows?

lines: Shahr-e-jaanan mein ab ba-safa kaun hai
couplets.en: Who in the beloved's city is still true at heart?

lines: Dast-e-qatil ke shayan raha kaun hai
couplets.en: Who is left worthy of the executioner's hand?
Gather what the heart still carries, you wounded ones, and come.

lines: Phir hamin qatl ho aayen yaaro chalo
couplets.en: Come, friends, let us be the ones to die again.
Come, let us walk through the bazaar in chains today.
